user.title: CanRider Telemetry
user.description: Your motorcycle's Supabase connection details (same ones the web dashboard uses).

data_description.supabase_key: The project's anon or publishable key (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in the web dashboard's .env). Do not use the service_role key here.
data_description.vehicle_id: The motorcycle's exact UUID, same value as NEXT_PUBLIC_VEHICLE_ID in the web dashboard. Not a free-form name.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Supabase. Check the URL and that the machine running Home Assistant has internet access.
error.invalid_auth: The Supabase key is not valid (401 error).
error.invalid_vehicle_id: The vehicle ID is not a valid UUID. Use the same UUID as the web dashboard (NEXT_PUBLIC_VEHICLE_ID), not a name like "test01".
